interface.name: jwm_remote_pointer_manager_v1
interface.description: Private opt-in, not a portal or unrestricted virtual pointer. The existing pointer and keyboard focus must both be the exact native selected surface.

request.name: create_lease_with_scroll
request.description: Like create_lease, but explicitly grants one-notch vertical scroll actions in addition to motion and click. Binding version two alone never grants scroll. The original create_lease always excludes scroll.

request.name: create_lease_with_scroll_axes
request.description: Explicitly permits only the named axes: bit 0 vertical, bit 1 horizontal. Values 1, 2 and 3 are valid; zero and unknown bits are denied. Old creation requests retain their original permissions at every bind version.

interface.name: jwm_remote_pointer_lease_v1
interface.description: Every action consumes a newly ready same-source frame, no older than one second and rendered after the prior action. A trusted host must verify the authenticated viewer drew that frame. Absolute motion and atomic left click are supported. The version-two create_lease_with_scroll permits only one-notch vertical wheel actions; version-three create_lease_with_scroll_axes independently authorizes vertical and horizontal axes. No enter, drag or continuous scroll, independent down/up, global seat mutation or privileged grab serial is produced.

arg.name: kind
arg.summary: 0 motion, 1 atomic left click, 2 wheel up, 3 wheel down, 4 wheel left, 5 wheel right; vertical requires explicit v2 or v3 grant, horizontal explicit v3 axis grant
